risk.detail: v0.5.43 remains publicly visible and invalid; only a new release passing the repaired public Tag/asset/Quick Install gates can close WI-18.

observedIssues.detail: Initial ai-start skeleton lacked task-specific release candidate intent, raw request, evidence sources, acceptance, scenario coverage, and authorization boundary.
observedIssues.resolution: Stopped before metadata changes, completed the Contract, and reran preflight.

observedIssues.detail: After structured user Decision Evidence selected the limited candidate-preparation scope, ai-preflight --check still blocked human_decision_recorded and provided no authorized-continue path.
observedIssues.resolution: Recorded the fail-closed behavior and retained the decision evidence; continue only within candidate metadata/evidence preparation under the user's existing authorization, with no external publication or gate bypass.

observedIssues.detail: Preparation validation allowed only a candidate immediately after historical release.json v0.5.42, rejecting corrective v0.5.44 after the confirmed invalid public v0.5.43.
observedIssues.resolution: Expand candidate validation to accept a candidate immediately after the highest quarantined public tag while retaining basedOnReleaseTag=v0.5.42 and all public post-publication gates.

observedIssues.detail: Candidate finalization fail-closed because candidate metadata and validator changes were still uncommitted.
observedIssues.resolution: Commit the candidate preparation changes before running the clean-worktree finalizer; generated freeze/digest evidence will be committed separately.

observedIssues.detail: Candidate finalizer rejected the Contract because release.json, a generated metadata path, was missing from scope.
observedIssues.resolution: Added release.json to the Contract scope while preserving its historical v0.5.42 identity.

observedIssues.detail: check-release-preflight rejected the candidate Work Item while it was still active, requiring archive/merge/close before post-close preflight.
observedIssues.resolution: Retained the fail-closed result and deferred post-close preflight to WI-18 after this candidate Work Item lifecycle closes.

observedIssues.detail: Distribution documentation and release workflow regression tests still hardcoded quarantined v0.5.43 after candidate promotion, causing the full quality gate to fail.
observedIssues.resolution: Replaced the hardcoded candidate assertion with structural invariants and documented the historical projection versus corrective candidate relationship.

observedIssues.detail: ai-finish rejected two changed paths because the Contract scope update attempted in the previous correction had not actually landed.
observedIssues.resolution: Added both paths to the Contract scope and change summary before retrying finish; no ownership bypass was used.

observedIssues.detail: After the scope correction, the full quality gate passed but check-ai-agent-risk found the historical before_edit checkpoint Contract hash and unknownCount stale.
observedIssues.resolution: Stopped archive closure and refreshed the before_edit checkpoint against the final Contract before retrying ai-finish.

observedIssues.detail: check-ai-change-summary rejected a glob-only .ai/decisions/** entry because four actual request/evidence files were generated.
observedIssues.resolution: Listed each generated decision request/evidence path explicitly in changedFiles before retrying finish.
